title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → AdmissionApplication
architecture_notes: Workday Student Recruiting & Admissions manages the prospect-to-applicant-to-admit lifecycle. An Application is submitted by a Prospect/Applicant for a specific Program of Study and academic period. Carries decision, decision date, and matriculation status. Equivalent to PS_ADM_APPL_DATA + PS_ADM_APPL_PROG.

source_objects.description: Admission application: applicant, program, period, admission type, status, decision. Equivalent to PS_ADM_APPL_DATA.
Decision and date: admit, deny, waitlist, defer. Equivalent to PS_ADM_APPL_PROG.PROG_ACTION.
The prospect/applicant person record. Links to Academic Person.
Required materials: transcripts, test scores, essays, recommendations. Equivalent to PS_CHECKLIST.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve to HELIX AcademicPeriod. The intended entry term.
Map to HELIX admission-status terminology (submitted, under_review, admitted, denied, waitlisted, deferred, withdrawn).

attribute_mappings.source: Student Application.Matriculated flag or resulting Student record
attribute_mappings.transformation: Boolean. True if the admit enrolled.
Boolean. True if all required items received.

notes: FERPA applies once the applicant becomes a student. Pre-matriculation applicant data handling follows institutional admissions privacy policy.
